film.title: Avantiqo — The Business Operating System
film.tone: premium feature-film business realism; intelligent, human, calm, consequential
film.editing_rule: voice is the spine; every spoken idea must trigger its matching visual proof
film.anti_boring_rule: within every 3-6 seconds at least one of location, business context, emotional intensity, camera language, product behavior, system state, or narrative purpose must materially change

voice_direction.delivery: measured, assured, intelligent; no trailer shouting and no generic corporate enthusiasm
voice_direction.music: restrained cinematic pulse that grows from human tension into confident momentum
voice_direction.sound_design: location truth first: room tone, service movement, kitchen, construction, vehicle, restrained UI confirmation cues
voice_direction.mix_rule: sound effects support meaning but never mask narration

beats.voice: A business does not run in a dashboard.
beats.primary_visual: Dawn over a real tropical business city; descend toward hotels, restaurants, offices, sites and service vehicles already moving.
beats.camera_and_edit: high aerial glide; cut on the first meaningful word after the opening breath
beats.transition_out: continue physical descent into one operating business
beats.proof: the film begins with lived economic activity rather than a product screen

beats.voice: It runs through thousands of decisions, happening while people work.
beats.meaning: Business execution is distributed and human.
beats.primary_visual: Hotel entrance comes alive: staff crossing, luggage movement, service preparation, real guests in depth.
beats.avantiqo_action: brief invisible-to-visible transition cue only; no full UI
beats.camera_and_edit: drone-to-gimbal handoff; human-scale movement replaces city scale
beats.transition_out: match movement into a prepared guest room
beats.proof: multiple simultaneous actors create operational complexity

beats.voice: A room is ready — until it isn't.
beats.meaning: Operational truth changes in the real world.
beats.primary_visual: Housekeeper checks airflow, notices cooling is wrong, pauses naturally; hands and face remain fully believable.
beats.avantiqo_action: at the last 1.2 seconds, a restrained spatially grounded issue cue begins to emerge from the edge of frame
beats.camera_and_edit: lateral move to the vent and reaction; no staged acting
beats.transition_out: circular vent match-cuts to vehicle wheel
beats.proof: human discovers the real exception before any software is shown

beats.voice: A field job changes before the technician arrives.
beats.primary_visual: Pest-control technician arrives at a commercial property, retrieves compact real equipment and walks toward site.
beats.avantiqo_action: show a 1.8-second real Operations task-state insert: assignment, priority and site context update; no generic dashboard
beats.camera_and_edit: low wheel match-cut into purposeful tracking shot; UI insert lands exactly on 'changes'
beats.proof: system state is tied to the exact field event

beats.voice: A project shifts when work, cost and timing collide.
beats.meaning: Operations and finance are one business truth.
beats.primary_visual: Construction supervisor moves beside active crews while a structural lift progresses.
beats.avantiqo_action: rapid, legible 2-second Projects/Finance composite: work package status changes and its cost impact resolves in the same beat
beats.camera_and_edit: restrained handheld tracking with architectural parallax; overlay anchored to physical movement, never floating sci-fi
beats.proof: one real-world event affects operational and financial state

beats.voice: And service never stops to wait for a report.
beats.meaning: The system must operate at business speed.
beats.primary_visual: Restaurant kitchen and floor accelerate into service: plating, pass, server motion, guests arriving.
beats.avantiqo_action: no long UI; use one precise confirmation pulse tied to a completed operational action
beats.camera_and_edit: macro-to-medium rhythm; cut on kitchen actions and music percussion
beats.proof: real work remains primary while intelligence supports it

beats.voice: Avantiqo sees the business as one connected operating system.
beats.primary_visual: Owner-manager at restaurant edge; foreground staff pass naturally while owner observes live service.
beats.avantiqo_action: first full product reveal: Finance, Operations, People, Supply Chain and Projects resolve into one coherent Avantiqo state, shown as fast editorial inserts rather than tiles floating over the actor
beats.camera_and_edit: controlled push-in; product inserts cut on noun phrases and return to the person before the sentence ends
beats.proof: domains are visibly connected through shared business context rather than shown as separate apps

beats.voice: It understands what changed, what matters, and what should happen next.
beats.meaning: Show Intelligence as decision support plus governed action.
beats.primary_visual: Same owner quietly asks Business Partner a question and listens; no device in hand.
beats.avantiqo_action: Business Partner insert shows concise situation synthesis, evidence-backed recommendation and one governed next action; no prompt box hero shot
beats.camera_and_edit: cut between real human timing and product evidence; recommendation appears on 'what matters', action appears on 'next'
beats.transition_out: owner approves with a small confident nod
beats.proof: intelligence moves from observation to an accountable action path

beats.voice: Finance is not a month-end mystery.
beats.meaning: Prove finance control without turning the film into a spreadsheet demo.
beats.primary_visual: Real finance operator or owner context, then precise Avantiqo Finance close-ups.
beats.avantiqo_action: invoice evidence -> VAT treatment -> reconciliation -> close blocker resolution, in one semantic chain; use real current Avantiqo UI states
beats.camera_and_edit: three sub-second-to-one-second product details, each entering on the exact financial noun; return to a human consequence at end
beats.transition_out: resolved finance state becomes a clean motion bridge into operations
beats.proof: the product demonstrates auditability, control and resolution rather than generic KPI charts

beats.voice: Operations is not a queue of problems waiting for someone to notice.
beats.primary_visual: Fast intercut: hotel room issue, field technician, restaurant service, construction supervision.
beats.avantiqo_action: issue -> owner -> action -> evidence -> resolved state; one loop only, shown clearly
beats.camera_and_edit: four real-world shots connected by action match-cuts; product appears only at decision points
beats.transition_out: resolved state creates a quiet half-beat
beats.proof: exceptions are owned and closed, not merely listed

beats.voice: The system can act — while control stays with the business.
beats.primary_visual: Human approves a consequential action; staff continue work naturally.
beats.avantiqo_action: show recommendation, authority boundary, approval or governed auto-action evidence, then successful completion state
beats.camera_and_edit: one clean human gesture synchronized to action execution; avoid dramatic AI visual effects
beats.proof: action authority and outcome are both visible

beats.voice: And when the business needs demand, Avantiqo can create for it.
beats.meaning: Bridge operating intelligence into Creative Studio.
beats.primary_visual: Luxury food campaign imagery begins: flame-kissed dish, cocktail detail, tactile hospitality cinematography.
beats.avantiqo_action: very brief Studio mission lineage: business objective -> approved concept -> production, then get out of the way of the creative result
beats.camera_and_edit: music opens wider; source cinema takes over frame
beats.transition_out: match warm highlights into evening venue
beats.proof: Creative is presented as business-connected production, not a prompt toy

beats.voice: Strategy, content and execution become one continuous loop.
beats.meaning: Creative output reconnects to business outcome.
beats.primary_visual: Premium evening hospitality campaign with real-looking guests and live entertainment energy.
beats.avantiqo_action: campaign output -> channel execution -> measured business response as restrained editorial inserts
beats.camera_and_edit: sweep from intimate human detail to wider emotional reveal
beats.transition_out: campaign energy match-cuts back into the real restaurant result
beats.proof: creation and execution are visibly part of the operating system

beats.voice: Less fragmentation. Faster decisions. More of the business under control.
beats.meaning: State the economic/operating consequence without unsupported metrics.
beats.primary_visual: Restaurant later in service, convincingly busy; staff move calmly and owner sees the result.
beats.avantiqo_action: three ultra-clean proof flashes aligned to the three phrases: connected state, decision completed, operation healthy
beats.camera_and_edit: slow pullback through layered human movement; narration becomes simpler as visual confidence rises
beats.transition_out: room sound and music resolve toward brand close
beats.proof: claim is qualitative unless measured source evidence exists

beats.voice: Avantiqo. One intelligence for the way a company actually runs.
beats.primary_visual: Stay on real people and real work for the first half, then transition to a restrained black brand end-frame.
beats.avantiqo_action: none; product has already been proven
beats.camera_and_edit: do not cut to a feature grid; preserve emotional result, then simple Avantiqo wordmark/end line
beats.transition_out: clean end on music resolve, no overlong logo animation
beats.proof: final impression is business consequence plus a clear category idea

picture_lock_checks: all 15 voice lines have semantically matching picture proof
no generic dashboard appears without a business cause or consequence
no generated human clip is present without AVANTIQO_INVESTOR_HUMAN_RELEASE_V1 authorization for the exact video digest
all Avantiqo UI shown is real current product UI or a deterministic composite derived from real current product UI
Finance sequence demonstrates evidence-to-resolution rather than a KPI montage
Operations sequence demonstrates issue-to-resolution rather than a queue montage
Business Partner sequence shows recommendation plus authority boundary plus action outcome
Creative Studio sequence shows business objective lineage and world-class output
no unsupported numeric investor claims are introduced
every visual hold longer than 2.5 seconds contains meaningful human, camera, product-state or narrative progression
brand close lasts no longer than required to read and remember it
